body:
## Review feedback addressed

Confirmed the branch state matches the reviewer's finding: `git diff origin/main...HEAD` is empty — commit `01e242c` fully reverted the nav link + doc changes added in `344fcd8`, per the prior review round. No further code changes are needed (there is nothing left to revert or add until the dependency branches land).

### Actions taken
- **Trello acceptance criteria corrected:** unchecked the 4 now-false items on the linked card ([card](https://trello.com/c/bzDu2nSL/11-as-a-visitor-i-want-the-changelog-linked-in-nav-and-docs-so-that-i-can-discover-it)) that claimed the nav entry and doc updates were shipped:
  - `lib/garage-content.ts` navGroups Explore group includes the Changelog entry
  - Visiting any page shows "Changelog" in the top nav
  - `docs/architecture.md` lists `/changelog` in the pages section
  - `docs/architecture.md` lists `lib/changelog.ts` alongside other lib modules
  (Left checked: "No changes required to `components/portal-nav.tsx`" and "test/typecheck/lint/build all pass" — both remain true of the current no-op diff.)
- **PR title/description:** the automation available to me in this session does not include an "edit PR title/description" action, so I'm flagging this transparently here rather than leaving it silently unaddressed. The title (`feat(nav): add Changelog link to Explore nav group and docs`) and description's test-plan checkboxes are now stale — they describe the reverted `344fcd8` change, not the current empty diff. Recommend a maintainer either:
  1. Close this PR (or convert to draft) until `feature/changelog-page` and `feature/changelog-data-feed` land on `main`, then reopen with the real nav link + doc changes, or
  2. Manually retitle/re-describe it (e.g. `chore: no-op, blocked on changelog page + data feed dependencies`) to reflect the current state.

No code changes were pushed since the working tree already matches this branch's remote HEAD (`01e242c`) with a clean, correct (empty) diff against `main`.

Pushed `31dc4f4`: added an in-code comment on the `Explore` nav group in `lib/garage-content.ts` documenting *why* the Changelog link is currently absent (blocked on `feature/changelog-page` + `feature/changelog-data-feed`) and exactly what to re-add once those land. This doesn't change behavior (still an empty functional diff vs. `main`, confirmed via `npm run test` (79 passing), `npm run typecheck`, `npx eslint lib/garage-content.ts --max-warnings 0`, and `npm run build` — no `/changelog` route present), but it means the repo itself now accurately reflects the current state rather than only comments/PR description explaining it.

Combined with the Trello acceptance-criteria corrections noted above, I believe this addresses the review's core concern (misleading claims of a shipped feature) as far as tooling in this session allows — the remaining ask (retitle/close the PR itself) needs to be done by a maintainer since I don't have a PR-edit/close action available.
